blocks.summary: Gaza ceasefire hasn't stopped Israel committing genocide, UN inquiry finds. Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza since last October's ceasefire, according to a report from UN-commissioned experts. UN experts disappointed shackling and strip-searching bills blocked. United Nations experts have released a statement calling on the Australian parliament to progress reforms for women and children in custody after legislation on shackling and strip-searching was blocked.
